stories.h: Five years for Puyallup WinCo stabbing and U-Haul chase
stories.s: A Level 3 sex offender was sentenced Friday to five years after slashing a WinCo loss-prevention worker with a box cutter and leading deputies on a chase in a commandeered U-Haul that ended in a crash.

stories.h: Kent man gets two years for Lakewood barista kidnap attempt
stories.s: A Kent man was sentenced to two years for trying to pull a bikini barista through a Lakewood drive-thru window in August 2025. He must register as a sex offender and stay away from drive-thru coffee stands.

stories.h: Puyallup man sentenced for 50,000 carfentanil pills
stories.s: A 37-year-old Puyallup man received five years in federal prison after a 2025 traffic stop near Centralia turned up over 50,000 pills containing carfentanil; investigators called him a supplier for a local ring.

coming.h: King tides peak on Puget Sound around Thanksgiving
coming.s: Supermoon-boosted king tides are expected to peak in Puget Sound around Thanksgiving and Black Friday; extreme flooding isn't expected but low-lying shorelines could see water.
